privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.content:
Introduction

Welcome to AlterLexis. Your privacy is critically important to us. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and how you can manage your information.

1. Data We Collect

To provide and improve our service, we collect the following information:

  • Account Information: When you create an account, we collect your email address and display name. Your password is encrypted and never stored in plain text.
  • Usage and Progress Data: We store data related to your activity on the platform, including your game scores, words mastered, game statistics (streaks, games played), badges earned, and learning preferences (native and target languages).
  • Premium Status: We store the expiration date of your Premium access if you choose to subscribe.
  • Technical Data: We use secure, http-only session cookies solely to keep you logged in. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.

2. How We Use Your Data

Your data is used exclusively for the following purposes:

  • To provide, operate, and maintain the core functionalities of the AlterLexis service.
  • To manage your account, including your progress, statistics, and preferences.
  • To personalize your learning experience.
  • To grant and manage access to Premium features.
  • To ensure the security of our application and prevent fraud.

3. Data Storage and Sharing

All your data is securely stored on Google Firebase services, a platform known for its robust security measures. We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal identification information to others. We only share data with essential service providers like Google (for hosting and database) and Gumroad (for payment processing) for the sole purpose of operating the application.

4. Your Rights and Control

We believe you should have full control over your data:

  • Access and Update: You can access and update your display name and learning preferences at any time directly from your Profile page.
  • Deletion: You can permanently delete your account and all associated data from the 'Danger Zone' section of your Profile page. This action is irreversible and will remove all your progress and personal information from our systems.

5. Policy Towards Children

AlterLexis is not directed to individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, we will take steps to delete such information.

6. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on this page. We encourage you to review this page periodically for any changes.

Last updated: August 17, 2025

termsPage.content:
1. Agreement to Terms

By creating an account and using our application AlterLexis (the “Service”), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Service.

2. Accounts

When you create an account, you must provide accurate and complete information. You are responsible for safeguarding your password and for any activities or actions that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

3. The Service and Freemium Model

AlterLexis provides a gamified vocabulary learning service. Our Freemium model includes:

  • Guest Access: Unlimited access to the 'Easy' difficulty level.
  • Free Registered Account: In addition to Guest access, you get to save your statistics and are granted a limited number of daily game plays on the 'Medium' difficulty level.
  • Premium Account: A paid subscription that grants unlimited access to all difficulty levels and features.

4. Premium Subscriptions

Premium access is granted by redeeming a key purchased through our third-party payment partner, Gumroad. This provides a license to use the Premium features for the duration specified at the time of purchase. As you are purchasing a digital product that is delivered immediately, all sales are final and non-refundable.

You agree not to use the Service to:

  • Violate any applicable laws or regulations.
  • Attempt to disrupt or compromise the integrity or security of the Service.
  • Engage in any form of cheating, exploit any bugs, or use automated scripts to gain an unfair advantage.

6. Intellectual Property

The Service and its original content (including the word database, visual design, and game mechanics), features, and functionality are and will remain the exclusive property of AlterLexis. Our trademarks and logo may not be used in connection with any product or service without our prior written consent.

7. Termination

You may terminate your account at any time by using the deletion feature on your Profile page. We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice or liability, if you breach these Terms.

8. Disclaimer of Warranty

The Service is provided on an “AS IS” and “AS AVAILABLE” basis. AlterLexis makes no warranties, express or implied, regarding the operation or availability of the Service, or that it will be uninterrupted or error-free.
